scope: Visual type/domain/tag audit of all167 base RAD card images; no full numeric or ability-text audit
limits: No absent power value was generalized to zero.
Gear raw might/mightBonus are not unit base Might. Nazuman Ntofo has printed+0 granted Might and Shield2; Protector Shield printed+1 grantsTank; Blade of the Exile printed+3 grantsGanking.
Printed metadata audit does not establish correctness of all energy/power/might/ability fields.
Only base167 images audited, not every variant.
Same-full-name variant reuse must retain base evidence ID; variant-only older champion reprints need existing canonical evidence or separate audit.
All six named rune domain glyphs visually verified, but no complete variant census claimed.
